title: Recover an exhausted database connection pool
symptoms: Connection acquisition waits while database queries remain healthy
preconditions: Identify the running pool owner through its database dependency and configured pool limit
Confirm at least 90 percent occupancy, acquisition wait above 100 ms and repeated acquisition timeouts from that owner
Confirm the database is running with query latency below 200 ms and upstream CPU remains normal
investigation: Compare acquisition wait with query execution latency to distinguish resource starvation from slow queries
Trace API, payment and worker timeout propagation back to the pool owner
Reject a diagnosis based only on one timeout record or elevated API latency

remediation.reason: Reset the exhausted connection pool at its owner while preserving the healthy database and upstream clients

follow_up: Restart is containment. Investigate pool sizing, connection hold time, acquisition cancellation and admission control before considering the issue permanently fixed.
